defaults.name: Mumen Anatomy
defaults.tagline: Anatomy explained simply, made for exam day.
defaults.intro: Every topic follows the same plan: a short explanation, my own video, real cadaver photos, 3D models, clinical cases, the five questions examiners ask most, and the histology you need.
